objective: Adrian signs the emergency-intervention authorization, completing his enrollment in the experimental-medicine program and securing his financial lifeline, while confronting the final bureaucratic hurdle of the trial.
intendedChange: Adrian signs the emergency-intervention authorization, completing his enrollment in the experimental-medicine program and securing his financial lifeline, while confronting the final bureaucratic hurdle of the trial.
prohibitedPatterns: Ending the chapter with a new external threat, accident, or cliffhanger.
Having Dr. Thorne offer emotional support, financial advice, or break clinical detachment.
Adrian engaging in personal conversation or revealing the full depth of his financial desperation.
Repeating the specific physical indignity of the specimen collection process as a primary scene event.
Using 'not X, but Y' contrast reframing in the prose or scene descriptions.

scenes.purpose: Adrian arrives at the clinic in a state of heightened physical distress, masking his symptoms to maintain his standing in the trial.
scenes.intendedChange: Adrian is seated in the waiting area, physically trembling and cognitively foggy, having successfully concealed his acute side effects from the receptionist and nurse.

scenes.purpose: Dr. Thorne presents the emergency-intervention authorization, explaining the specific loss of bodily autonomy required for the final enrollment step.
scenes.intendedChange: Adrian holds the signed authorization document, having read the clauses that permit the research team to override his consent in a medical emergency, while Thorne maintains strict clinical distance.

scenes.purpose: Adrian signs the authorization, completing his enrollment and securing the full financial commitment of the trial.
scenes.intendedChange: Adrian has signed the final document, his enrollment is officially complete, and he leaves the clinic with the full weight of his new obligations and the relief of secured income.
